stage: retrospective archive reuse; landmarks chosen after inspecting mean curves
hypothesis: U_j(p)=a_j D_j(phi(p)), j=A,E; independent constant amplitudes; one increasing endpoint-fixed phi; no Jacobian
primary_necessary_gate: A alone: its three ordered interior critical heights must be proportional
null: U features minus D features equal zero
uncertainty: leave out one common batch across all shapes/orientations/fields; recompute each landmark and normalization; retain full joint covariance
reference: 2D Gaussian Wald statistic; exploratory nominal p, not independent validation
endpoint_rule: Do not infer population endpoint vanishing orders from sparse empirical tail coefficients
